prompt: `src/trailhead/report.py` has no tests. Write `tests/test_report.py` with pytest tests that check its behaviour as documented in the README and the docstrings. Don't change anything under `src/`.
bash_commands: git ls-files && cat README.md && cat src/trailhead/report.py && ls tests; cat pyproject.toml
cat tests/conftest.py src/trailhead/track.py src/trailhead/elevation.py src/trailhead/geo.py src/trailhead/pace.py; cat tests/test_plan.py | head -50; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5
python -m pytest -q tests/test_report.py 2>&1 | tail -40; ruff check tests/test_report.py 2>&1 | tail -20

python - <<'EOF'
p='tests/test_report.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""        assert summarise(track, fitness=fitness).hours == pytest.approx(planned, abs=0.01 * len(days))""",
"""        # Each day's hours are rounded to 0.01, hence the tolerance.
        expected = pytest.approx(planned, abs=0.01 * len(days))
        assert summarise(track, fitness=fitness).hours == expected""")
s=s.replace('''        f"0,0,1000\\n"''','''        "0,0,1000\\n"''')
s=s.replace("""    assert lines[5] == "  time      3h 00m"
    assert lines[6] == "  heading   E"
    assert isclose(summarise(track).steepest_pct, 6.0)""","""    assert lines[4] == "  steepest  6.0%"
    assert lines[5] == "  time      3h 00m"
    assert lines[6] == "  heading   E\"""")
s=s.replace("from math import isclose\n\n","")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
ruff check tests && python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3; git status --short
ruff check --fix tests/test_report.py && ruff check && python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3; git diff --stat src
